name: Pacific Auto Company
old_description: Since 1983, Pacific Best Inc. (PBI) has been a trusted manufacturer and distributor of automotive cooling products. We offer a wide range of products, including radiators, condensers, fan assemblies, intercoolers, external oil coolers, cabin air filters, door mirrors, and more for most makes and models. With distribution centers in Virginia, Texas, and California, we provide fast delivery and exceptional service nationwide and beyond. Our commitment to customer service, high fill rates, and rapid shipping ensures our clients can serve their customers efficiently and with maximum satisfaction. Our manufacturing partners utilize the most advanced equipment and are operated by experienced, professional teams. At Pacific Best Inc., we place a strong emphasis on process control to ensure uncompromised quality. Our partners are ISO/TS16949 certified and are dedicated to producing premium-quality products at the most competitive prices.
about:
Pacific Auto Company, operating as Pacific Best Inc., was established in 1983 in Paramount, California, within the Los Angeles metropolitan area. The company began as a warehouse distributor of automotive collision body parts and cooling products, serving the Southern California repair market.

Today, Pacific Auto Company maintains six distribution centers across Southern California, supported by over nine warehouses and a dedicated delivery fleet. The company stocks a complete line of aftermarket collision parts — including radiators, condensers, fan assemblies, intercoolers, external oil coolers, cabin air filters, door mirrors, and lighting — all certified to meet OEM replacement standards. Its lighting products comply with DOT/SAE regulations, and it carries an extensive selection of CAPA- and NSF-certified body parts. The firm reports over 30 million parts sold since inception.

The distributor serves a broad base of automotive repair professionals: collision repair shops, auto body shops, jobbers, insurance providers, estimation services, auto parts retailers, dealerships, restoration specialists, and wrecking yards. Its coverage area spans eight Southern California counties — Santa Barbara, Kern, Ventura, Los Angeles, San Bernardino, Riverside, and Orange — with guaranteed 24-hour delivery on business days.

Pacific Auto Company differentiates itself through a no-contract, no-buy-in account structure, volume discount programs, and a procurement team that uses data analytics to maintain high fill rates. The company emphasizes competitive pricing on every order and a quality administration system designed to streamline ordering and same-day dispatch.
